notes: Selected full-trial 30-day in-hospital mortality, as reported in the abstract and full paper; row.json specifies Mortality without a narrower population or timepoint. Analyses were intention-to-treat at the level of each patient’s hospitalization; discharged patients could enroll again on readmission. Balanced crystalloids includes lactated Ringer’s solution or Plasma-Lyte A, not separate randomized arms. Other full-trial mortality timepoints in Table 2 (balanced crystalloids, saline): before ICU discharge, 528 (6.6%) and 572 (7.3%); before 60 days, 928 (11.7%) and 975 (12.4%). The sepsis subgroup has 30-day in-hospital mortality percentages of 25.2% and 29.4%. The held NCT02444988 registry results cover the medical-ICU subset: 418 deaths among 2735 balanced-crystalloid patients and 467 among 2646 saline patients, at 30 days censored at hospital discharge; these subset results were not substituted for the full trial.
